query:
SELECT
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE completed_at IS NULL
                      AND dead_at IS NULL
                      AND attempts = 0
                ) AS "pending!",
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE completed_at IS NULL
                      AND dead_at IS NULL
                      AND attempts > 0
                ) AS "retrying!",
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL
                ) AS "completed!",
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE dead_at IS NOT NULL
                ) AS "dead!"
            FROM inbox_receipts
